page.content:
Rap-debate songs in which Hamilton and Jefferson argue policy before Washington.

How Cabinet Battle connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — The Cabinet Battles are set-piece songs inside Hamilton.
  • Character: Thomas Jefferson — Jefferson faces Hamilton across the Cabinet Battle desks.
  • Character: Alexander Hamilton — Hamilton argues assumption and neutrality in the Cabinet Battles.
  • Character: George Washington — Washington referees the Cabinet Battles.

What is Cabinet Battle?

Cabinet Battle is the pair of songs that turn Washington's Cabinet into a rap battle: assumption and the debt in the first, France and neutrality in the second, Jefferson versus Hamilton at the desks.

Key threads lead to Hamilton (musical), Thomas Jefferson, Alexander Hamilton and George Washington.
